subject: Next steps & MAP: Stratus Logistics pilot — procurement timeline and production criteria
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@stratuslogi.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Recap & mutual action plan draft — Stratus pilot

Hi Maya (and Carlos),

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum. I focused this on the three buyer groups you surfaced: Ops (latency & throughput), Security/Compliance, and Procurement/Budget.

Key pain & goals (as I heard them)
- High-volume batch scoring at the edge with 200ms P95 target; current infra fluctuates 300–700ms.
- Cost sensitivity once moving beyond pilot — need predictable unit economics per 1M tokens/day.
- SOC2 + audit log requirements for vendor selection; dedicated tenancy preferred for PII-handling flows.

Proposed MAP (owners & dates)
1) Pilot kickoff (data integration + baseline tests) — Owner: Stratus Data Eng (Maya) / Redwood SE (Aditya) — Target start: 2027-01-10
2) 2-week performance run (latency/throughput, reduced-batch config) — Owner: Ops leads — 2027-01-24 to 2027-02-07
3) Security review & evidence exchange (SOC2, retention, KMS) — Owner: Stratus Security (Carlos) / Redwood Security — Due: 2027-02-10
4) Contract/procurement review & initial commercial (pricing guardrails + pilot credit) — Owner: Stratus Procurement / Redwood Sales (Lauren) — Decision target: 2027-03-01
5) Production readiness & phased roll-out (SLA thresholds, rollback playbook) — Owner: Stratus Ops / Redwood Platform — Go/no-go: 2027-03-15

Open questions for your team
- Will you require VPC/private deployment for the pilot, or is Dedicated capacity in our hosted offering acceptable for baseline tests?
- Any non-negotiable audit artifacts beyond SOC2 and access logs (e.g., HSM attestation)?
- Who is the procurement approver that signs PO above $250k?

Attachments: I attached a draft MAP spreadsheet and our short security questionnaire for your InfoSec to review.

Next step: if the dates above look reasonable, I’ll update the MAP and circulate a one-page summary for procurement.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Recap & mutual action plan draft — Stratus pilot

Tessa,

Appreciate the clear summary — this lines up with our internal read. A few clarifications from my side:
- We can start integration on 2027-01-10, but Ops wants the performance run to include a simulated peak-hour load that mirrors holiday routing (we'll provide a sample trace).
- InfoSec asked for a short call with your security lead before Feb 10 to confirm the scope of evidence (SOC2 + logging should be sufficient, but they want to confirm retention windows and KMS options).
- Procurement: our VP of Procurement (Anjali Menon) reviews POs >$150k and will need a one-pager on unit economics and termination terms.

I'll confirm who will be the primary tech owner for the performance run by end of day; Carlos and I will coordinate the InfoSec call.

—Maya
Maya Patel

Subject: Internal: security artifacts & pricing options for Stratus

Tessa / Lauren,

Following up on the MAP — I attached the security questionnaire pre-filled with our standard answers where applicable, and I sketched two pricing trajectories for the pilot -> production transition:
- Option A (hosted, dedicated pool): lower operational overhead, slightly higher unit cost during pilot; good if they want a quick start without VPC onboarding.
- Option B (private/VPC): lower variable unit cost at scale, higher one-time onboarding (networking + KMS), preferred if they plan to move sensitive traffic on day one.

Notes: Procurement threshold note — Maya flagged PO >$150k (Anjali). We should prepare a one-pager on termination SLA and data handling for Anjali. Also recommend offering a 6-week pilot credit that covers the first heavy benchmarking run to remove friction.

Attaching: redwood_security_qs.pdf (pre-filled), pricing_options_stratus_v1.xlsx

-Aditya

Hi Maya / Carlos — looping back with an updated MAP and a concise set of asks so procurement and InfoSec have what they need.

Updated MAP (final draft)
- Pilot kickoff: 2027-01-10 — Deliverable: baseline latency report + integration checklist — Owner: Stratus Data Eng / Redwood SE
- Performance run: 2027-01-24 to 2027-02-07 — Deliverable: P95 & throughput report under peak trace — Owner: Stratus Ops / Redwood Platform
- Security evidence call: propose 2027-02-02 (30 min) — Owner: Stratus Security / Redwood Security
- Procurement decision & PO: target 2027-03-01 — Deliverable: one-page commercial summary + T&C highlights — Owner: Stratus Procurement / Redwood Sales
- Production rollout (phase 1): target 2027-03-15 — Deliverable: runbook & rollback criteria — Owner: Stratus Ops / Redwood Platform

Asks (short list)
1) Can you confirm the procurement approver (name & email) for POs >$150k?
2) Does your InfoSec prefer a short synchronous call on Feb 2 or Feb 3?
3) If you want Dedicated vs VPC for pilot, we’ll need network contacts to start the onboarding checklist by 2027-01-03.

If that all looks good I’ll: (a) lock the MAP into the shared Drive link; (b) prepare the one-pager for Anjali; (c) send calendar invites for the security call and pilot kickoff.

Best,
